text: Despite the significant impact from the COVID-19 pandemic, we delivered double-digit revenue growth in 2020 to leverage improved profitability and cash generation. In 2020, results were in line with guidance, with improved profitability and more than half of Total Revenue coming from our New Medicines. Product Sales were up 10% (11% at CER) to $25,890 million, and Total Revenue from New Medicines improved by 33% (33% at CER) to $13,950 million.
justification: This argument focuses on the company's financial and operational performance during 2020, highlighting revenue growth, profitability, and sales figures.

text: 2020 was a remarkable year for AstraZeneca as we pursued our growth through innovation strategy. Our patient-centric strategy, focus on innovation, and capital-allocation priorities remain unchanged, with sustainable growth in revenue, profit, and cash generation set to continue. Total Revenue is expected to increase by a low-teens percentage in 2021, accompanied by faster growth in Core EPS to $4.75 to $5.00. The proposed acquisition of Alexion is believed to accelerate the combined company’s strategic ambitions, improve profitability, and strengthen cash flow.
justification: This argument outlines the company's strategic vision, future growth expectations, and plans for acquisition to enhance its competitive positioning.

text: The Board took the decision early in the pandemic to conclude our agreement with the University of Oxford to develop, manufacture, and supply their potential vaccine to prevent COVID-19. This decision aligned with our Purpose and was a practical way to help in a time of health crisis. We committed to developing and supplying the vaccine at no profit during the pandemic, reflecting our commitment to operating sustainably and ethically.
justification: This argument emphasizes the company's mission-driven actions and ethical commitments during the pandemic, reflecting its core values and social responsibility.

text: Our commitment to sustainability includes our Ambition Zero Carbon target, which contributes to tackling the climate crisis. We have made progress against the requirements of the Taskforce on Climate-related Financial Disclosures and sourced 99.9% of our imported electricity globally from renewable sources in 2020.
justification: This argument focuses on the company's environmental and sustainability commitments, highlighting its efforts to reduce carbon footprint and promote renewable energy.

text: At the AGM in April, Geneviève Berger and Graham Chipchase intend to retire from the Board after nine years of service. Their successors have been appointed, with Nazneen Rahman taking over sustainability oversight and Philip Broadley succeeding as senior independent Non-Executive Director. The Chairman, Leif Johansson, will seek re-election to lead the Board’s oversight of the proposed acquisition of Alexion, reflecting careful succession planning aligned with UK corporate governance best practices.
justification: This argument addresses board composition, succession planning, and governance practices, focusing on leadership continuity and compliance.

text: Our response to the pandemic included repurposing existing compounds and developing a potential long-acting antibody (LAAB) combination against the virus, AZD7442. After the SARS-CoV-2 gene sequence was published in January 2020, we rapidly screened thousands of antibodies and identified a combination of two potent neutralising antibodies designed to reduce resistance and increase therapy durability for six to 12 months. By running early development processes in parallel, we started Phase I trials in August and Phase III trials in October, reducing timelines from years to months.
justification: This argument details the company's scientific and product development efforts in response to COVID-19, highlighting innovation and accelerated R&D.

text: Throughout the pandemic, we put patients first by working closely with investigators and accelerating digital health technologies in R&D to keep clinical trials running. We continued more than 80% of our studies using electronic consent, remote data collection, and devices to collect patient data from home. We also made over 2,400 shipments to patients’ homes in more than 60 studies across 35 countries, ensuring treatment continuity.
justification: This argument focuses on product-related patient care and clinical trial management innovations during the pandemic.

text: Despite the pandemic, employees worked tirelessly to ensure patient safety and continued access to care and medicines. We focused on protecting staff and critical operations, played a leading role in scientific innovation to combat the virus, and contributed to society through emergency relief. Our success in both growth through innovation and pandemic response is rooted in being true to our Purpose and living our Values.
justification: This argument highlights the company's internal culture, employee dedication, and social contributions, reflecting its mission and values.

text: We delivered 29 approvals of new medicines or life-cycle management indications in major markets in 2020. Additionally, we had 14 data or regulatory designations for accelerated, priority, or expedited review. Our new medicines include Tagrisso, Imfinzi, Lynparza, Calquence, Enhertu, Koselugo, Farxiga, Brilinta, Lokelma, roxadustat, Fasenra, Bevespi, and Breztri.
justification: This argument presents product pipeline achievements and regulatory successes, emphasizing innovation and product development.

text: We delivered strong results in 2020 despite the pandemic, including nearly 20 new launches across major markets. We accelerated patient-centred care by increasing awareness and early diagnosis of chronic kidney disease using digital partners, and by enabling self-diagnosis and specialist consultation for respiratory diseases through digital tools like chatbots. The number of patients self-administering Fasenra more than doubled in 2020, offering safer management during COVID-19.
justification: This argument describes strategic initiatives to improve patient care and expand market presence through innovation and digital transformation.

text: We managed our global supply chain and inventory to protect medicine supply during the pandemic, handling over 1,300 global logistics routes and moving products close to patients despite border closures and restrictions. Staff temperature monitoring and over 22,000 COVID-19 assessments ensured operational continuity. These efforts resulted in 91 on-time product launches and outstanding stock availability levels of 99.5% globally.
justification: This argument focuses on operational performance and supply chain management to maintain product availability during challenging conditions.

text: We are committed to doing the right thing by fostering inclusion and diversity, which drives creativity, innovation, and performance. In 2020, we developed a comprehensive plan to address racial equity issues in clinical trial design and enrollment, and in attracting, retaining, and developing ethnic minority talent. Our Ambition Zero Carbon commitment follows a greenhouse gas hierarchy to reduce emissions, and we made significant progress sourcing renewable electricity globally.
justification: This argument highlights the company's social responsibility efforts focused on diversity, equity, and environmental sustainability.

text: During 2020, the Nomination and Governance Committee and the Board carefully considered succession plans for senior Board roles including Chairman, CEO, and CFO. There is a clear understanding of the sequencing of succession over a sensible period, ensuring leadership continuity and governance stability.
justification: This argument addresses governance through planned leadership succession and board oversight.

text: The proposed acquisition of Alexion is intended to accelerate AstraZeneca’s commercial and scientific evolution, improve profitability, and strengthen cash flow. More information will be provided ahead of the shareholders’ general meeting where approval will be sought.
justification: This argument presents a forward-looking strategic move aimed at growth and enhanced competitive positioning.
